core_problem_solved: To provide a standard set of annotations for controlling the data binding process (Java objects to/from JSON) within the Jackson ecosystem, allowing developers to declaratively configure serialization and deserialization behavior directly in their POJOs.
key_features: Annotations for handling polymorphism and custom serialization/deserialization logic
Annotations for controlling object creation and views
era_and_niche: A core, foundational component of the Jackson data-processing library, which is the de facto standard for JSON handling in the Java ecosystem. It is a modern, actively maintained, and ubiquitous library.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is a fundamental part of the Jackson project. Migration away from it would only occur if a project decided to switch its entire JSON processing framework to an alternative like Gson, which uses its own set of annotations.
